name: Email OTP challenge
description: Temporary challenges used to verify codes sent to users by email.

user_id.label: User
user_id.description: User for whom the email OTP challenge was issued.
user_id.help: Links the challenge to the account that must provide the emailed code.

code_hash.label: Code hash
code_hash.description: Hash of the temporary code sent by email.
code_hash.help: Stores a non-reversible representation of the code used for verification.

expires_at.label: Expires at
expires_at.description: Date and time after which the challenge can no longer be completed.
expires_at.help: Codes submitted after this time are rejected.

failed_attempts.label: Failed attempts
failed_attempts.description: Number of unsuccessful attempts to complete the challenge.
failed_attempts.help: The challenge is invalidated when the configured attempt limit is exceeded.

status.label: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle status of the email OTP challenge.
status.help: Indicates whether the challenge is pending, consumed, or invalidated.

consumed_at.label: Consumed at
consumed_at.description: Date and time when the challenge was successfully completed.
consumed_at.help: Empty until the correct code is submitted.

invalidated_at.label: Invalidated at
invalidated_at.description: Date and time when the challenge was invalidated.
invalidated_at.help: Empty while the challenge remains pending or was successfully consumed.

invalidated_reason.label: Invalidation reason
invalidated_reason.description: Reason why the challenge was invalidated.
invalidated_reason.help: Records whether the challenge expired, was superseded, or exceeded its attempt limit.

list.default.name: Email OTP challenges
list.default.description: List of email OTP authentication challenges.
